protocol.container: v4 flat blocks for all conditions, including none
protocol.ordering: One full warmup/config, then shuffled condition/round jobs; encode followed by fresh-process restore. All range jobs shuffled separately.
protocol.transforms: Explicit 2-byte word grid resets each block; tail literal. No int/float parsing, channel separation or sample prediction semantics.
protocol.selection: Ordinary codec first, then selected transform+same codec; use only if payload gain exceeds local label cost. Full metadata cost reported; policy may still lose overall.
protocol.integrity: Unchanged bounded decompression, manifest/block/file SHA and external bytewise restore/range truth; deterministic archives each round.
protocol.persistence: Temporary file, flush/fsync, atomic replace and full archive digest, identical across methods.
protocol.ranges: Same original byte requests per round across every configuration/mode. 64KiB-grid cross_chunk windows may not cross a 1MiB block.
protocol.cache: Full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; no decoded-block cache; fresh process per phase/range trial.
protocol.cost: Entire archive including prefix, JSON, file paths/hashes, block metadata and payload. No native library/model/dictionary; shared Python/codec not fully allocated.
protocol.rss: Fresh phase processes; range includes truth and metadata ledger, not production RSS

limits: single host; five default rounds are descriptive, not confidence intervals
one EEG and one ECG record, not full databases or floating-point-array evaluation
byte-word transforms cover original embedded text/annotation bytes too; no semantic field parser
synthetic noise is a fallback/cost control, not a third scientific dataset
no claim against all specialist scientific compressors or optimal word/stride layouts
